demo.title: Interference FFT matches direct DFT energy
demo.code: const x=[1,0,-1,0,1,0,-1,0];function dft(k){let re=0,im=0;for(let n=0;n<x.length;n++){re+=x[n]*Math.cos(2*PI*k*n/x.length);im-=x[n]*Math.sin(2*PI*k*n/x.length);}return re*re+im*im;}const E=x.reduce((a,b)=>a+b*b,0);let S=0;for(let k=0;k<x.length;k++)S+=dft(k);J({parseval:+Math.abs(S/x.length-E).toFixed(9)});assert(Math.abs(S/x.length-E)<1e-9,'fft');

demo.title: Wave-equation step conserves energy
demo.code: let u=[0,1,0,-1,0],up=u.slice(),un=new Array(5).fill(0);const c2=0.25,N=5;function En(a,b){let s=0;for(let i=0;i<N;i++)s+=a[i]*a[i]+(a[i]-b[i])*(a[i]-b[i]);return s;}const e0=En(u,up);for(let s=0;s<20;s++){for(let i=0;i<N;i++)un[i]=2*u[i]-up[i]+c2*(u[(i+1)%N]-2*u[i]+u[(i-1+N)%N]);up=u;u=un.slice();}const e1=En(u,up);J({energy_initial:+e0.toFixed(3),energy_final:+e1.toFixed(3)});assert(Math.abs(e1-e0)/e0<0.1,'wave');
